title: Cricbet99 Privacy Policy
subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information to ensure a safe and secure betting environment.
intro: At Cricbet99, your privacy is our top priority. We follow strict data-handling practices to ensure that your personal and financial details are always protected. This policy outlines how we handle the information you provide when using our official platform and WhatsApp support channels.
We only collect the minimum amount of data required to provide you with a secure gaming experience, verify your identity, and process your financial transactions reliably.

By using Cricbet99, you consent to the data practices described in this document. We review our privacy protocols regularly to stay aligned with global security standards and local Indian regulations.
